name: diary-week-fdw1
description: Согласованность недели календаря «Дневника» при first_day_of_week=1: подписи столбцов, заголовок строки недели, клик по строке недели, клик по дню и предопределённый набор «Мои записи за неделю». Даты НЕ зашиты: сид и ожидания вычисляются от текущего дня прогона (ошибка 42b7c183), поэтому сценарий не краснеет от смены календарной даты. Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.diary-week-fdw1.scenario.json --out .tmp/etn-42b7c183/fdw1

steps.name: prepare-dates
steps.eval: (() => { const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); const now = new Date(); const today = `${now.getFullYear()}-${pad(now.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(now.getDate())}`; const utc = (day) => new Date(day + 'T00:00:00Z'); const add = (day, n) => new Date(utc(day).getTime() + n * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const mondayIdx = (day) => (utc(day).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7; const fdw = 1; const weekStart = add(today, -((utc(today).getUTCDay() - (fdw % 7) + 7) % 7)); const weekDays = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => add(weekStart, i)); const monthFirst = today.slice(0, 7) + '-01'; const lead = (utc(monthFirst).getUTCDay() - (fdw % 7) + 7) % 7; const gridStart = add(monthFirst, -lead); const isoWeek = (day) => { const thursday = add(day, -mondayIdx(day) + 3); const jan4 = `${thursday.slice(0, 4)}-01-04`; const week1 = add(jan4, -mondayIdx(jan4) + 3); return Math.round((utc(thursday).getTime() - utc(week1).getTime()) / (7 * 86400000)) + 1; }; const titles = []; for (let w = 0; w < 6; w += 1) { const days = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => add(gridStart, w * 7 + i)); titles.push(`Неделя ${isoWeek(days[3])}: ${days[0]} — ${days[6]}`); } const clickDay = weekDays[3]; const offset = Math.round((utc(clickDay).getTime() - utc(today).getTime()) / 86400000); const shift = offset === 0 ? '' : `${offset > 0 ? '+' : '−'}${Math.abs(offset)}`; window.__diaryDates = { today, weekStart, weekDays, titles, clickDay, shift }; return { today, weekStart, clickDay, shift }; })()

steps.name: expected-week-state
steps.probe: ({ days: 7, dayKeys: window.__diaryDates.weekDays, selected: 7, selectedDays: window.__diaryDates.weekDays, from: '$weekStart', to: '$weekEnd' })

steps.name: seed-week
steps.eval: (async () => { const nid = '{{networkId}}'; const seed = '{{thoughtId}}'; const days = window.__diaryDates.weekDays; const mk = async (title, day) => { const t = new Date(day + 'T12:00:00').toISOString(); return window.etn.comments.create(nid, 'thought', seed, { kind: 'chronological', title, body_md: 'запись ' + day, valid_from: t, valid_to: t }); }; for (const d of days) { await mk('Д ' + d, d); } return days.length; })()

steps.name: click-week-row
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.chron-cal .cal-week')).find((e) => (e.getAttribute('title') || '').includes(window.__diaryDates.weekStart)); if (!b) throw new Error('нет строки недели ' + window.__diaryDates.weekStart); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

steps.name: week-row-state
steps.probe: ({ days: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day').length, dayKeys: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day')).map((e) => e.dataset.day), selected: document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected').length, selectedDays: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected')).map((e) => e.getAttribute('title')), from: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] select')?.value ?? null, to: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="to"] select')?.value ?? null })

steps.name: click-day
steps.eval: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.chron-cal .cal-day')).find((e) => e.getAttribute('title') === window.__diaryDates.clickDay); if (!b) throw new Error('нет дня ' + window.__diaryDates.clickDay); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()

steps.name: day-state
steps.probe: ({ days: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day').length, selected: document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected').length, from: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] select')?.value ?? null, shift: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] .fv-date__shift')?.value ?? null })

steps.name: open-saved
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .ff-extra--saved'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return true; })()
